title: GenerationRequest
description: Body of POST /api/runs. failureModes items are taxonomy.json keys — validated against the loaded taxonomy at the application level on both sides, not hardcoded here, so this schema and taxonomy.json can't drift apart.

language.description: MVP supports exactly one target. A const, not an enum, so widening it later is a visible, deliberate schema change.

failureModes.description: Taxonomy item keys the user asked to have planted. Empty array means the generator's choice.

sourceMaterial.description: Any combination may be present; all are optional.
